{{Quote|Sir, I am a librarian. I am here to assist you in whichever way you deem felicitous."<br />"Sent by whom?"<br />"Sector Admiral Poteet, sir.|PRC-3 and Atour Riten converse|<ref name="DSn" />}}
'''Sector admiral''' was a position in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. Sector Admiral [[Poteet]] dispatched [[Librarian droid/Legends|librarian droid]] [[P-RC3]] to the [[Death Star Library]] for duty, where the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] worked under [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Atour Riten]].<ref name="DSn" />
